motivation: verify whether low-register K2/K3 harmonic evidence improves after a true duration-preserving waveform pitch shift, rather than magnitude-only spectral warping
population: B_low + base prediction K3 + true K in {2,3}; low register defined from original FIT bottom tertile
pitch_shift_method: librosa.effects.pitch_shift, duration-preserving, local pre+post waveform, then recompute fine-STFT and harmonic features
tests: train/evaluate on the same naturally-low rows under each waveform-shifted representation
train on natural high-register FIT rows and evaluate on waveform-shifted low-register validation rows
